proposed.title: Iron Fist S1#10
proposed.text: Danny learns that Colleen belongs to Bakuto's faction of the Hand and turns on her, but she opens the academy gate so he and Davos can escape.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Colleen's boyfriend and fighting partner, who learns she belongs to the Hand.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, part of the Hand, who helps him escape it.

changes.evidence: Iron Fist S1#10 (Black Tiger Steals Heart): Danny learns Bakuto's Hand is Colleen's faction, confronts her and asks if her feelings were staged; she still opens the gate for his escape. In S1#11 she proves her feelings and they reconcile. A betrayal and reconciliation with no stage between S1#7 and S2#8.

Their only encounter is The Defenders#1 in the Phnom Penh sewers: Elektra kills Shaft and fights Danny while Colleen stays with the dying man. They never speak, and Colleen is not in Elektra's later scenes (the restaurant, Stick's death, the cavern under Midland Circle, where Colleen is upstairs with Claire). One shared fight is not a connection.

owner_calls.question: Does their romance end in Iron Fist S2? Stages 1 to 3 (S2#8 to S2#10) keep kind 'partner' and call them boyfriend and girlfriend.
options: Change stage 3 (S2#10) to say they part with a last kiss and Danny leaves New York, cards 'ex-boyfriend'/'ex-girlfriend', kind kept
Also add the S2#7 split, when Colleen agrees to train Danny only if she separates herself from him
owner_calls.evidence: Iron Fist S2#7: Colleen says training Danny means she must separate herself emotionally from him, and they 'effectively ended their relationship' (fandom). S2#10: they say they will always be bonded, kiss one last time, and Danny leaves New York, leaving a letter saying he loves her. Wikipedia's summary does not call it a breakup.
